title: SWE-Dev: Building Software Engineering Agents with Training and Inference Scaling
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: ACL 2025
authors_zh: Haoran Wang、Zhenyu Hou、Yao Wei、Jie Tang、Yuxiao Dong
paper_type_zh: 软件工程智能体训练数据、可执行测试构造与扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究仓库级代码智能体后训练、fail-to-pass 验证、轨迹筛选、训练/推理扩展以及数据可审计性的读者
one_line: SWE-Dev constructs repository repair tasks and fail-to-pass tests, releases 20,147 SFT/RFT-format OpenHands records, and studies trajectory and iteration scaling, while row-level lineage and replay remain incomplete.
SWE-Dev 从仓库修复任务构造 fail-to-pass 测试并发布 20,147 条 SFT/RFT 格式的 OpenHands 记录，用于研究训练与迭代扩展；但逐条来源、环境重放和污染审计仍不完整。
why: It makes an executable-feedback pipeline for software-agent post-training inspectable, but also shows why released message traces, scores, and benchmark gains are insufficient without source, environment, and contamination evidence.
inclusion_reason: An official software-engineering-agent release and construction recipe combining repository tasks, synthesized executable tests, OpenHands trajectories, and outcome-style filtering; its open audit gaps make it useful both as a training-recipe reference and as a provenance/replay case study.

title: Problem
问题
html:
SWE-Dev addresses a concrete post-training bottleneck for repository-level software engineering agents: issue/patch records often lack executable tests that can tell a useful repair from an ungrounded patch. The primary publication is Findings of ACL 2025, pp. 3742–3761 (ACL Anthology 2025.findings-acl.193; arXiv v2). It is about building and using a data-and-environment pipeline, not a claim that test-passing alone establishes real-world engineering quality.

The paper begins with PyPI packages that expose GitHub URLs, applies repository filters, and extracts issue/PR-derived repair instances. It reports 38,000 retained instances from 4,413 repositories. A task is more than an issue: the intended unit includes repository context, a problem statement and reference patch, a synthesized or existing test, an executable before/after check, and—where rollout collection succeeds—an OpenHands message trajectory. The current public training release is a different object: 20,147 rows across sft (17,871) and rft (2,276), each with a message list plus five scalar/string fields, not a complete replay bundle.

This Card belongs to environment_agent_trajectory_data because the central supervision is attached to interaction in a repository environment and a test-derived terminal condition. It is not a new held-out benchmark, a general code corpus, or proof that every released trace is high quality. L4 depth is supported for screening the data object, test contract, release schema, and major audit gaps; row-level source lineage, snapshotting, and evaluation-contamination evidence remain unknown. (Paper §3.1–§3.3; official HF dataset API checked 2026-07-23.)

SWE-Dev 针对仓库级软件工程智能体后训练中的一个具体瓶颈：许多 issue/patch 记录没有可执行测试，因而无法区分有用修复与缺乏依据的补丁。其主要出版物是 Findings of ACL 2025，第 3742–3761 页（ACL Anthology 2025.findings-acl.193；arXiv v2）。论文讨论的是数据与环境流水线的构造和使用，并未声称“测试通过”本身就能证明真实工程质量。

论文从包含 GitHub URL 的 PyPI 包开始，筛选仓库并抽取由 issue/PR 派生的修复实例，报告从 4,413 个仓库保留了 38,000 个实例。一个任务不只是 issue：其意图单元包括仓库上下文、问题描述和参考补丁、合成或现有测试、可执行的修复前/后检查，以及在 rollout 成功收集时的 OpenHands 消息轨迹。当前公开训练发布物是另一种对象：sft 17,871 行、rft 2,276 行，共 20,147 行；每行有消息列表和五个标量/字符串字段，而不是完整的可重放包。

本 Card 归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为核心监督附着于仓库环境中的交互以及由测试导出的终止条件。它不是新的留出 benchmark、通用代码语料，也不能证明每条公开轨迹都高质量。现有证据足以将数据对象、测试契约、发布 schema 和主要审计缺口写到 L4 深度；逐条来源、快照固定和评测污染证据仍为 unknown。（论文 §3.1–§3.3；官方 HF 数据集 API 于 2026-07-23 检查。）

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a chained contract: turn issue/patch-derived repository tasks into test-backed tasks, use those tasks to collect agent trajectories, then select trajectories with both executable and LLM-mediated signals. Test construction is staged rather than one-shot: repository information is extracted, an LLM writes a Gherkin scenario, another generation step writes pytest-style test code, and a traceback-guided revision can repair a bad generated test. The target condition is fail-to-pass (F2P): the test should fail before the reference patch and pass after it. (Paper Fig. 2; §3.2; Appendix A.1.)

The paper adds a second selection layer for model trajectories. DeepSeek-V3 operates through OpenHands; Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct compares the model patch with the reference patch and labels it identical, mostly, partially, or different. The reported filtering rule keeps only identical or mostly trajectories, approximately 65% of the original set. Thus executable feedback observes a particular before/after behavior, while the LLM judge observes textual/code-patch similarity. Neither signal observes all semantic requirements, hidden regressions, or data provenance.

The closest background is issue/patch data and SWE datasets with existing tests (including SWE-bench-style collections and SWE-Gym). SWE-Dev's distinguishing unit is the explicit synthesis of missing F2P tests plus trajectory collection and patch-quality filtering. It is a direction signal for executable-feedback data construction, not evidence that a scalar reward or an LLM comparison is a universally reliable verifier.

该工作的核心贡献是一条串联契约：把由 issue/patch 派生的仓库任务变为有测试支撑的任务，用这些任务收集智能体轨迹，再用可执行信号和 LLM 中介信号选择轨迹。测试构造不是一次生成：先抽取仓库信息，LLM 写出 Gherkin 场景，后续生成步骤写出 pytest 风格测试代码；生成的测试不正确时还可根据 traceback 修订。目标条件是 fail-to-pass（F2P）：测试应在参考补丁之前失败、在参考补丁之后通过。（论文图 2、§3.2、附录 A.1。）

论文还为模型轨迹增加第二层筛选。DeepSeek-V3 通过 OpenHands 运行；Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 将模型补丁与参考补丁比较，标记为 identical、mostly、partially 或 different。报告的规则只保留 identical 或 mostly 的轨迹，约占原始集合的 65%。因此，可执行反馈观察的是某一特定修复前/后行为，LLM judge 观察的是文本/代码补丁相似性；两者都不能观察全部语义要求、隐藏回归或数据来源。

最接近的背景是 issue/patch 数据以及带有现有测试的 SWE 数据集（包括 SWE-bench 风格集合和 SWE-Gym）。SWE-Dev 的差异在于显式合成缺失的 F2P 测试，再收集轨迹并筛选补丁质量。它是构造可执行反馈数据的一种方向信号，而不是标量 reward 或 LLM 比较在所有场景下都可靠的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs. The collection pipeline crawls 240k PyPI packages with GitHub URLs, retains 59k repositories after Stars ≥5 and PRs ≥3 filters, downloads 10,416 repositories, extracts 88k instances, and retains 38k from 4,413 repositories after filtering. The retained task provides issue/patch context; a complete public per-task source manifest was not found. (Paper §3.1; Appendix A.2.)

Construction and verification. From a 26k-instance subset, the authors generate 2,097 F2P functions; with existing tests, this yields 4,630 tests. Context extraction feeds Gherkin description generation, test-code generation, optional traceback revision, and execution. A valid test is intended to fail on the original repository state and pass after the reference patch. The repository offers Docker (Ubuntu 22.04) and non-Docker evaluator commands, but not a published digest/lock/replay record for every episode. (Paper §3.2; GitHub README and Dockerfile.)

Rollout, selection, and use. DeepSeek-V3 runs an OpenHands ReAct-like agent at 30 iterations and 32k max tokens in the ordinary experiments. The paper reports roughly 17k unevaluated and 2.3k correct trajectories. For the filtered scaling study, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct retains identical/mostly patch comparisons. The paper studies SFT/RFT, KTO, and OREO with OpenRLHF; it does not establish a universal reward model. The released dataset instead exposes input, from, f2p_pass, f2p_count, reward, and instance_id; the semantics of from and every reward value, plus row-to-paper mapping, are not disclosed. Reproduction should pin the HF revision, GitHub commit, image/dependency versions, source snapshots, prompts, seeds, and commands before treating it as trainable data.

输入。 收集流水线爬取 24 万个带 GitHub URL 的 PyPI 包，经 Stars ≥5、PRs ≥3 筛选后保留 5.9 万个仓库，下载 10,416 个仓库，抽取 8.8 万个实例，再经筛选从 4,413 个仓库保留 3.8 万个。保留任务提供 issue/patch 上下文；未找到完整的公开逐任务来源清单。（论文 §3.1；附录 A.2。）

构造与验证。 作者从 2.6 万实例子集中生成 2,097 个 F2P 函数；加上现有测试后共有 4,630 个测试。上下文抽取依次供给 Gherkin 描述生成、测试代码生成、可选的 traceback 修订和执行。一个有效测试应在原始仓库状态失败、在参考补丁之后通过。代码仓库提供 Docker（Ubuntu 22.04）和非 Docker evaluator 命令，但没有发布每个 episode 的镜像 digest、依赖锁定或重放记录。（论文 §3.2；GitHub README 与 Dockerfile。）

rollout、选择与用途。 在常规实验中，DeepSeek-V3 以 30 次迭代、32k max tokens 在 OpenHands 的 ReAct-like agent 中运行。论文报告约 1.7 万条未评估轨迹和 2,300 条正确轨迹。对过滤后的扩展研究，Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 保留 identical/mostly 的补丁比较。论文用 OpenRLHF 研究 SFT/RFT、KTO 与 OREO，并未建立通用 reward model。公开数据集只暴露 input、from、f2p_pass、f2p_count、reward 和 instance_id；from、每个 reward 值的语义以及行到论文实验的映射均未披露。复现或训练前应固定 HF revision、GitHub commit、镜像/依赖版本、来源快照、prompt、seed 和命令。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The test-generation evidence is conditional. On the Table 1 comparison, the mixed description/code setup produces 92 instances with F2P tests, compared with 73 for Llama, 81 for Mistral, and 83 for Qwen in that experiment; this is not an independent audit of all released tests. In the downstream comparison, 900-trajectory RFT reports 15.87% for SWE-Dev versus 15.80% for Nebius, and 500-trajectory RFT reports 15.00% versus 14.87%; each configuration is independently run three times. These results evaluate a particular 7B setup and do not certify individual records. (Paper Tables 1 and 3.)

For training methods, the 7B experiment reports 16.2% with 1,000 RFT trajectories and 18.0% with 2,000; with 2,300 trajectories RFT reaches 21.2% and is reported above the RFT+OREO and OREO-only configurations. KTO and OREO reach 17.2% and 17.0%, respectively, at 1,800 trajectories. The authors' interpretation is that RFT gives the strongest result under their setup, not that offline RL is ineffective in general. (Paper §4.3, Figs. 4–5.)

On SWE-bench-Verified, the paper reports 23.4% for SWE-Dev-7B and 36.6% for SWE-Dev-32B. Under iteration scaling, 7B rises from 21.8% at 30 rounds to 23.4% at 75; 32B rises from 34.0% to 36.6%. The benchmark has 500 human-validated instances according to the paper, and evaluation uses developer-written unit tests. These are downstream model results under the stated scaffold and budgets, not a direct measure of dataset correctness, record diversity, license fitness, or freedom from overlap. (Paper §4.1, Table 4, Fig. 7.)

测试生成证据有明确条件。在表 1 的比较中，混合的描述/代码设置在该实验中得到 92 个带 F2P 测试的实例，Llama、Mistral 和 Qwen 分别为 73、81 和 83；这不是对全部公开测试的独立审计。在下游比较中，900 条轨迹的 RFT 报告 SWE-Dev 为 15.87%、Nebius 为 15.80%，500 条轨迹时分别为 15.00% 和 14.87%；每个配置独立运行三次。这些结果只评估了一个特定的 7B 设置，不能认证单条记录。（论文表 1、表 3。）

在训练方法上，7B 实验报告 1,000 条 RFT 轨迹时为 16.2%，2,000 条时为 18.0%；2,300 条时 RFT 达到 21.2%，高于报告的 RFT+OREO 和仅 OREO 配置。KTO 与 OREO 在 1,800 条轨迹时分别达到 17.2% 和 17.0%。作者的解释是 RFT 在其设置下结果最强，而非 offline RL 在一般情形下无效。（论文 §4.3、图 4–5。）

在 SWE-bench-Verified 上，论文报告 SWE-Dev-7B 为 23.4%，SWE-Dev-32B 为 36.6%。在迭代扩展中，7B 从 30 轮的 21.8% 提升至 75 轮的 23.4%；32B 从 34.0% 提升至 36.6%。论文称该 benchmark 有 500 个经人工验证的实例，评测使用开发者编写的单元测试。这些是在既定 scaffold 和预算下的下游模型结果，不是数据集正确性、记录多样性、许可证适配性或无重叠的直接度量。（论文 §4.1、表 4、图 7。）

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier SWE collections commonly begin from historical issue/patch pairs and either rely on available tests or expend effort validating selected tasks. SWE-Dev's specific change is to make missing-test construction a first-class intermediate artifact: it uses repository context and the reference patch to generate a Gherkin scenario and executable test, validates the F2P condition, then uses the resulting environment to obtain and filter agent trajectories. Its public release also exposes message-format rows in two training configurations rather than only a benchmark task list.

The paper's other distinct research question is scaling within one agent run. Instead of only repeated independent samples, it varies the interaction-round budget from 30 to 75 and reports improvements with diminishing returns. It also compares RFT, KTO, and OREO under a common task setting. These are empirical recipe components; OpenHands, ReAct-like interaction, reference patches, pytest execution, rejection sampling, and offline-RL objectives are not newly introduced by this paper.

For reasoning-data research, the useful novelty is the interface between a synthetic test and a trajectory-selection decision: a row can in principle be connected to a task, an executable signal, and a training choice. Before reuse, check whether that connection is actually released for the required revision. Here it is not: no immutable record-level manifests link public messages to source commits, generated tests, runtime logs, LLM judgments, or benchmark-exclusion decisions. Therefore the novelty supports studying a construction recipe, not assuming an auditable ready-to-train corpus.

较早的 SWE 集合通常从历史 issue/patch 对开始，要么依赖已有测试，要么投入人工验证选中的任务。SWE-Dev 的具体改变是把“缺失测试构造”设为一等中间产物：它利用仓库上下文和参考补丁生成 Gherkin 场景与可执行测试，验证 F2P 条件，再使用所得环境收集并筛选智能体轨迹。公开发布物还以两种训练配置提供消息格式行，而不只提供 benchmark 任务列表。

论文的另一项独特研究问题是在一次 agent run 内进行扩展。它不只进行重复的独立采样，而是把交互轮数预算从 30 变到 75，并报告了收益及其递减；它还在共同任务设置下比较 RFT、KTO 与 OREO。这些是经验性的 recipe 组件；OpenHands、ReAct-like 交互、参考补丁、pytest 执行、rejection sampling 和 offline-RL 目标都不是该论文新提出的。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，有价值的新接口在于合成测试与轨迹选择决策之间的连接：一行记录原则上可连接到任务、可执行信号和训练选择。复用前应检查该连接是否确实随所需 revision 发布；此处并没有。不存在把公开消息逐条连接到来源 commit、生成测试、运行日志、LLM 判断或 benchmark 排除决定的不可变清单。因此，这一新意支持研究构造 recipe，而不能把它当作已审计、可直接训练的语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The executable contract is narrower than semantic correctness. A generated test can pass after the reference patch because it encodes implementation details, accidentally depends on setup, or misses an important regression. Conversely, a semantically valid repair can fail a brittle generated test. The paper acknowledges many unsuccessful test-generation cases arise from environmental constraints, but does not release enough per-case execution material to distinguish environment failure, generation error, and issue ambiguity independently. (Paper §3.2.)

The LLM filter creates a second failure surface. Patch comparison against a reference patch can reward textual similarity or an incomplete interpretation of behavior; identical/mostly retention can select away novel valid solutions and hides the discarded distribution. This is a curator inference from the disclosed filtering mechanism, not an author-validated error rate. The paper does not publish a human-label calibration, threshold analysis, or row-level comparator rationale.

Release and audit limits matter for reuse. The current HF artifact has 20,147 rows and a small six-column schema, yet lacks per-row repository state, source issue/PR, patch, test file, Docker digest, command, log, decision trace, and license record. No dataset license is declared, no documented dev/test split or SWE-bench-Verified overlap audit is available, and paper/release counts lack a reconciliation manifest. The code and 32B model are MIT, but that does not transfer rights for upstream content. The model results are neither an independent reproduction nor a data-quality audit.

可执行契约比语义正确性更窄。生成的测试可能因为编码了实现细节、偶然依赖 setup，或漏掉重要回归而在参考补丁后通过；反过来，语义有效的修复也可能被脆弱的生成测试拒绝。论文承认大量未成功的测试生成案例来自环境约束，但没有发布足够的逐例执行材料，无法独立区分环境失败、生成错误和 issue 歧义。（论文 §3.2。）

LLM filter 还引入第二个失败面。将补丁与参考补丁比较可能奖励文本相似性或对行为的不完整理解；保留 identical/mostly 可能筛掉新颖但有效的解决方案，并隐藏被舍弃的分布。这是基于已披露筛选机制的 curator inference，而非作者验证的错误率。论文没有发布人工标注校准、阈值分析或逐行 comparator rationale。

发布与审计限制影响复用。当前 HF artifact 有 20,147 行和仅六列的 schema，但缺少逐行仓库状态、来源 issue/PR、补丁、测试文件、Docker digest、命令、日志、决策轨迹和许可证记录。没有声明数据集许可证，没有文档化的 dev/test split 或 SWE-bench-Verified 重叠审计，论文与发布计数也没有对账清单。代码和 32B 模型是 MIT，但这不会自动转移上游内容权利。模型结果既不是独立复现，也不是数据质量审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, use SWE-Dev as a recipe and audit reference. A builder can reproduce the conceptual modules—repository intake, context extraction, Gherkin/test generation, F2P execution, trajectory collection, patch comparison, and selection—then replace the undisclosed pieces with versioned manifests and independent test/judge audits. The paper is also useful for a controlled ablation: compare unfiltered trajectories, executable-test-qualified trajectories, and LLM-comparator-qualified trajectories while reporting retained failures and costs.

It can inform evaluation design: record the before/after test state separately from an LLM patch judgment, and evaluate iteration budgets rather than conflating multi-round interaction with pass@k. Its reported 30–75 round curve supplies a baseline hypothesis about diminishing returns, not a budget policy for another environment. The official code may serve as an implementation starting point after pinning its commit and inspecting configuration, API-key handling, dependency versions, and evaluator isolation.

Reuse class: blocked pending verification for direct training reuse. The public rows can be studied as released artifacts and used for schema/audit tooling, but a new trainer should not assume they are licensed, replayable, non-contaminated, or correctly linked to their reward without the missing manifest, rights review, and validation. Benchmark comparison is suitable only as downstream evidence under a declared overlap policy.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，应把 SWE-Dev 用作 recipe 与审计参考。构建者可以复现其概念模块——仓库接入、上下文抽取、Gherkin/测试生成、F2P 执行、轨迹收集、补丁比较和选择——再用有版本的清单和独立的测试/judge 审计替代未披露部分。论文也适合做受控 ablation：比较未过滤轨迹、经可执行测试限定的轨迹和经 LLM comparator 限定的轨迹，同时报告被保留的失败样本和成本。

它可指导 evaluation 设计：把修复前/后的测试状态与 LLM 补丁判断分开记录，并评估迭代预算，而非把多轮交互与 pass@k 混为一谈。报告的 30–75 轮曲线只是关于收益递减的基线假设，并不是其他环境的预算策略。官方代码可在固定 commit 后作为实现起点，但仍需检查配置、API-key 处理、依赖版本和 evaluator 隔离。

复用等级：直接训练复用 blocked pending verification。公开行可作为已发布 artifact 被研究，也可用于 schema/审计工具；但新的训练者不应假定它们已获许可、可重放、无污染，或在没有缺失清单、权利审查和验证的情况下与 reward 正确关联。benchmark 比较只适合作为有明确重叠政策时的下游证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1–§3.2 and Appendix A.1 before treating “test-backed” as a quality label: the test is generated from issue, reference-patch, and code context, so it is neither hidden nor independent of the intended solution.
  • Keep three counts separate: 38k retained source instances, 4,630 tests after 2,097 generated F2P functions plus existing tests, and 20,147 released SFT/RFT-format rows. The paper does not supply a manifest that maps these populations one-to-one.
  • The public reward fields are not a substitute for the paper's two contracts. F2P is an execution relation; the trajectory filter is a four-way LLM patch comparison. Inspect the dataset revision and code rather than guessing their row-level encoding.
  • Read Fig. 6 with Fig. 7: training-data and interaction-round scaling are separate interventions. The 36.6% result includes the stated evaluation scaffold and 75-round setting, not a dataset-only effect.
  • Pair this card with SWE-smith for a contrasting environment-first construction recipe, and with trajectory-audit cards before deciding whether an agent trace is suitable for training. Priority follow-up: obtain a pinned row-level lineage/replay/rights manifest and a SWE-bench-Verified overlap audit.

• 在把“有测试支撑”当作质量标签前，先阅读 §3.1–§3.2 和附录 A.1：测试由 issue、参考补丁和代码上下文生成，因此它既不是隐藏测试，也不独立于预期解法。
  • 必须区分三组计数：3.8 万个保留来源实例、由 2,097 个生成 F2P 函数加现有测试得到的 4,630 个测试，以及 20,147 行公开的 SFT/RFT 格式记录。论文没有提供把这些总体一一对应的清单。
  • 公开 reward 字段不能替代论文的两种契约。F2P 是执行关系；轨迹 filter 是四分类 LLM 补丁比较。应检查数据集 revision 和代码，而不是猜测它们在逐行中的编码。
  • 将图 6 与图 7 一起阅读：训练数据量和交互轮数扩展是两种不同干预。36.6% 结果包含既定 evaluation scaffold 和 75 轮设置，不是纯数据集效应。
  • 可与 SWE-smith 一起阅读以对照 environment-first 构造 recipe，并在判断 agent trace 是否适合训练前阅读 trajectory-audit 卡片。优先后续工作：获取固定版本的逐行 lineage/replay/rights 清单以及 SWE-bench-Verified 重叠审计。
